# Exploratory analysis

Goals: Tease apart contributions of mutations across the ribozyme sequence to catalysis and leak, and test other hypotheses about the data.

## Preliminary setup

```{r loadStuff}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse, quietly = TRUE)
library(magrittr) # for special Tee pipe operator %T>% (Error check, unique WT before calc)
library(patchwork) # for combining plots

# import functions
source("functions/0.data_processing.R")
source("functions/1.plotting.R")
source("functions/2.contribution_table.R")
source("functions/3.spatial_plot.R")

# locate the data
base_path <- "enrichment_data/theoAptzepPCR_lokya/"
# file_path <- str_c(base_path, "subset.tsv") # for testing
file_path <- str_c(base_path, "DiMSum_Project_variant_data_merge.tsv") # for production

# global variables
expected_variants <- 135000 # (epPCR) from colony counts (source: Lokya)
count_tracker <- tibble(
  threshold = numeric(),
  variants = numeric(),
  input_reads = numeric(),
  filtered_columns = character()) # global variable to track counts at different thresholds
```

## Data cleanup

- Select relevant columns
- Clean up column names
- Calculate enrichment, leak metrics Ref: \_Borrowing some code from DiMSum/[split-multiinputs.R](https://github.com/ppreshant/DiMSum/blob/master/scripts/split_multiinputs.R)

```{r data-cleanup}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

data <- read_and_cleanup_data(file_path)
cat("Column names: ", paste(colnames(data), collapse = ", "), "\n")

total_variants <- nrow(data)
total_reads <- sum(data$Input_count)

# count_tracker <- count_tracker |>

#           filtered_columns = "")

cat("Total reads: ", format(total_reads, big.mark = ","), "\n")
```

## Convert dot-bracket structure for plotting

```{r parse-dotbracket}
source("functions/3.spatial_plot.R") # temp

hhrzTheoAptaz_db <- ".(((((((((....((((((.......((((......)))).......(((((.(((((.......))))).))))).))))))....)))))))))."
secondary_structure <- parse_dotbracket(hhrzTheoAptaz_db)

# Add annotations for key positions manually
# annotations for positions of interest
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "red") + 
  annotate("rect", xmin = 21, xmax = 27, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.1, fill = "orange") + # ribozyme core
  annotate("text", x = 24, y = 2.5, label = "Core", vjust = -1, color = "darkorange3") +

  # communication modules
  annotate("rect", xmin = 49, xmax = 53, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.1, fill = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = 51, y = 2.5, label = "CM1", vjust = -1, color = "blue") +

  annotate("rect", xmin = 73, xmax = 77, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.1, fill = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = 75, y = 2.5, label = "CM2", vjust = -1, color = "blue") +
  
  # aptamer
  annotate("text", x = 63, y = 2.5, label = "Aptamer", vjust = -1) +

annotation_df <- bind_rows(
  secondary_structure,
  tibble(Name = "Core", start = 21, end = 27, colour = "orange"),
  tibble(Name = "CM1", start = 49, end = 53, colour = "blue"),
  tibble(Name = "CM2", start = 73, end = 77, colour = "blue"),
  tibble(Name = "Aptamer", start = 63, end = 63, colour = NA)

)

```

# Mapping contribution to each nucleotide position

## Mapping catalysis scores across the ribozyme sequence

The table below counts substitutions and sums the WT-normalised score changes
for each destination nucleotide at each position. Indels are excluded, and a multi-mutant contributes its complete score change to each of its substitutions.

```{r contribution_data_net_cat}
subset_data <- filter_list_25[[3]]$filtered # count >= 2

contribution1 <- make_contribution_table(subset_data)

source("functions/1.plotting.R") # temp

# plot total_net catalysis across positions
plot_contribution_across_sequence(contribution1, "total_net_catalysis_mean")

```

## Show secondary structure with contribution scores

```{r}
plot_contribution_across_sequence(contribution1, "total_net_catalysis_mean", annotation_df = annotation_df)
```


## Relative catalysis scores across the ribozyme sequence

```{r contribution_data_rel_cat}

# plot total_relative catalysis across positions
plot_contribution_across_sequence(contribution1, "total_relative_catalysis_mean")

```

## Relative leak scores across the ribozyme sequence

```{r contribution_data_rel_leak}

# plot total_relative catalysis across positions
plot_contribution_across_sequence(contribution1, "total_relative_leak_mean")
```
